method.api: GitHub GET git/trees/{tree_sha}?recursive=1 for both snapshots
method.algorithm: Path-exact Git blob SHA/mode/size set reconciliation over entire untruncated trees. Preserve all added/modified/removed paths and blob IDs. Code/asset labels are path/extension hints only.
limits: ZERO line-level semantic credit; byte contents were not fetched by this diff.
Code-like path labels are candidates and may include fixtures; do not treat as exact complete execution graph.
Binary/text classification is not determined from bytes. Binary_by_extension is an unverified asset hint.
New history, prior audits, files and member data preserved; not all actual changed source lines inspected.
Future commits after live source pin require separate reconciliation.
